notes: M5 local implementation and its immutable reviewed evidence remain valid. Current staging evidence retains the clean v0.1.30 40-case aggregate baseline, one later control-plane abort, and two complete repeats that each contain one distinct system failure. Release v0.1.32 then replaces the expired provider route with grok-4.6 and passes the two targeted failure cases citation-contract-dispute and fact-retention-legal-hold with all applicable quality metrics at 1.0, complete usage telemetry, no repair, no fallback, and zero system failures. This bounded sample does not close repeatability and the full suite was deliberately not rerun. Continue with a sanitized representative enterprise corpus with reviewed labels, provider revision and billing inputs, managed observability ownership, representative capacity evidence, and human semantic review before another full-suite run. These are active manual-gate tasks on the current delivery path; only M6-R5 requires another server or independent fault domain.
